verdict.rationale: Salv documents real-time payment screening in which the caller receives the decision in the API response while the payment is still in flight, so it can be held before release [salv-docs-13, salv-docs-25]. Name matches raise alerts, which can carry AI-Powered Insights explaining why a name matched; matching is configurable per field (fuzzy or exact) [salv-docs-15, salv-docs-19]. Alerts can be worked and audited through clearance rules, cases and alert status updates [salv-docs-11, salv-docs-18, salv-docs-29]. missing for 10: explicit documentation of what the screening response or alert view contains (the matched list entries, scores and fields), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
